Interface StatefulCommand<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of object that the command operates on.
All Superinterfaces:
SemiStatefulCommand
All Known Subinterfaces:
KeyedStatefulCommand
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractTransform, ExtrudeCmd, OrbitCmd, PrismCmd, QuickTranslateCmd, RotateSelection, ScaleSelection, TranslateSelection
public interface StatefulCommand<T> extends SemiStatefulCommand
A command that can be in one of two states: running or not running. When a stateful command is running, it takes over the input stream and waits for a specific event to occur. This event can be either the 'Enter' key being pressed, which confirms the command and executes its 'onEnter' method, or the 'Escape' key being pressed, which cancels the command and executes its 'onEsc' method.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
